notes: Each entry's 'categories' field is an array of one or more of the topCategories codes above — an item can belong to multiple categories at once (e.g. a TV series can be tagged both 'tvseries' and its release-decade code). For entries tagged with a split decade (1980s/1990s/2000s/2010s), also set 'year' to the exact release year so the site can offer a year-level filter within that decade. For double/triple features spanning more than one year (and, typically, more than one decade), add an optional 'years' array listing every relevant release year (e.g. [1965, 1971]) — the site will match the item under any of those years' filters, while 'year' still holds the earliest date for display purposes.
